markdown.description: Full visible page content as Markdown in natural reading order. Include headings and body text exactly as visible. Preserve tables as Markdown tables or HTML tables. Preserve standalone formulas as LaTeX using $$...$$ or \[...\]. Preserve inline formulas as LaTeX using $...$. Do not describe images or figures unless there is a visible caption, label, or text associated with the image. Do not add explanations that are not visible on the page.
